panels.title: How the estimate is built
panels.description: Explains where the cost numbers come from, what they leave out, and the per-instance-hour rates used.

options.content:
Costs are **estimated** from instance counts in Cloud Monitoring multiplied by Cloud Run list prices for asia-southeast1 (Tier 2), read from the Cloud Billing catalog on 2026-10-05. They are not the bill.

Not counted: Artifact Registry storage, Compute Engine disks, network egress, Cloud Build, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Monitoring, and the free tier. Credit left is not visible to this project (the billing account is owner-only).

Rates in USD per instance-hour (the `state` label of `instance_count` is `active` or `idle`):

| service | active | idle |
|---|---|---|
| colpali | 1.705104 | 1.705104 |
| gateway | 0.38016 | 0.38016 |
| colbert | 0.29232 | 0.0756 |
| grobid | 0.17136 | 0.063 |

panels.title: Estimated cost now ($/h)
panels.description: Estimated Cloud Run spend per hour, per service and in total; each active/idle term is its own math expression and the services and total are summed in the panel (Add field from calculation, sum across row) so a missing series counts as zero instead of blanking the total.

panels.title: At this rate: per day / per 30 days
panels.description: Total estimated cost extrapolated from the current rate to 24 hours and 720 hours, computed in the panel (not a server-side expression) for the same missing-series reason as the Estimated cost now panel.

panels.title: Average $/h in the selected range
panels.description: Average estimated total $/h over the selected time range (Grafana expressions cannot multiply by the range length, so this shows the mean rate; multiply by the hours in the range for the spend).

panels.title: Estimated $/h by service
panels.description: Estimated Cloud Run spend per hour over time, stacked by service.

panels.title: Succeeded
panels.description: Analyses that finished with status done, among those started in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) as count
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' = 'done' and $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Analyses that ended with status error, among those started in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) as count
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' = 'error' and $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Analyses currently in status running, among those started in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) as count
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' = 'running' and $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Done divided by done plus error for analyses started in the selected range; empty when none have finished.

targets.rawSql:
select
  case when count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error')) = 0 then null
  else count(*) filter (where data->>'status' = 'done')::float8 / count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error'))
  end as success_rate
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Per day: succeeded vs failed
panels.description: Finished analyses per day by outcome (done or error), by the day they started.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  data->>'status' as metric,
  count(*) as value
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' in ('done', 'error') and $__timeFilter(started)
group by 1, 2
order by 1

panels.title: Run time p50 / p95 (minutes)
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile run time of finished analyses, first stage to last stage timestamp; runs without timestamps are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select id, started, data,
    (select min((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as first_at,
    (select max((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as last_at
  from public.analyses
  where data->>'status' in ('done', 'error') and $__timeFilter(started)
)
select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (last_at - first_at) / 60.0) as "p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by (last_at - first_at) / 60.0) as "p95"
from s
where first_at is not null and last_at is not null and last_at > first_at

panels.title: Each run
panels.description: The 100 newest analyses in the range with status, run time and last stage; owners and paper titles are deliberately not shown.

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select id, started, data,
    (select min((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as first_at,
    (select max((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as last_at
  from public.analyses
  where $__timeFilter(started)
)
select id,
  started,
  data->>'status' as status,
  round((case
    when data->>'status' = 'running' then extract(epoch from (now() - started))
    when first_at is not null and last_at is not null then last_at - first_at
  end / 60.0)::numeric, 1) as minutes,
  data->'stages'->-1->>'stage' as "last stage",
  left(data->>'message', 120) as message
from s
order by started desc
limit 100
